sanjay: Heads-up — spotted a steady KV hit-rate drop on long-context sessions (sessions >60k tokens) starting 2024-03-10. Eviction counters jump and residency tail is widening. Posting quick traces + dashboard link.
ella: Can you call out which model/kernels and which fleet? is this localized or widespread?
sanjay: Mostly on llama-2-13B variants running on A100 and some q4 variants. Trend shows up across a few racks, not single host. Evictions_total +45% vs baseline for those sessions; residency_p99 down from ~98% to ~72% when session length crosses ~40k tokens.
jamie: ugh. Any obvious correlation with batching heuristics or kernel switches during long sessions?
sanjay: Not obvious from sampling. I grabbed a small profiler trace and a prom query: ```promql
sum by (kernel) (rate(kv_evictions_total[5m]))
sum by (session_bucket) (histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(kv_residency_percentiles_bucket[10m])))
``` The eviction-age histogram shows a secondary mode at ~30s which wasn't there before.
ops-bot: Deploy-bot: canary rollout to rack-7 at 2024-03-09T22:12:08Z (image: runtime:v2.18.0-canary)
ella: Could the canary have changed kernel selection or GC thresholds? runtime:v2.18 had the compactness tweak last week.
sanjay: That's my suspicion — compactness-algorithm change plus slightly more aggressive batching -> more churn in page allocations. The profiler shows more page splits on insert-heavy long chats.
lucy: I sketched a small dashboard diff that adds eviction-age histogram, hotset reuse ratio, and per-session residency percentiles. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/grafana-dashboards/pull/412
jamie: I can bump the samplers to increase long-session sampling and run an extended trace on rack-7 tonight. Will also revert compactness flag in a canary if we see reproduction.
sanjay: Thanks. Action items: 1) Lucy merges dashboard additions (eviction-age + reuse ratio). 2) Jamie increases sampler and runs 1h profile on affected hosts. 3) Add alert: if sum(rate(kv_evictions_total[5m])) by (shard) > 10 for 5m -> page ops on-call. 4) Short canary revert if profiler confirms compactness regression.
ella: For the alert, also add condition on residency_p95 < 85% to reduce noise.
jamie: Doing sampler change now — pushing small config. will post traces once done. :thumbsup:
sanjay: Uploaded a raw flamegraph + mini trace to the thread: https://artifacts.redwood/internal/kv-traces/2423578901/trace1.html :eyes:
lucy: Nice flamegraph. I marked the page split hotspots in the dashboard patch. Also added a query for reuse_ratio = kv_fragments_reused / kv_fragments_allocated.
sanjay: If anyone sees regressing customer latencies, escalate and we'll yank canary. Otherwise we should be able to mitigate with sampler + alerting and a targeted rollback. :handshake:
jamie: Update: sampler increased to 1%->5% for long sessions at 2423579200. starting trace now.
sanjay: Great — will watch dashboards. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
